en.name: Apache Iceberg
en.summary: Open table format for huge analytic datasets. Snapshot-based, schema-evolution-safe, engine-agnostic.

en.name: Apache Spark
en.summary: Distributed compute engine for large-scale data processing. Most mature Iceberg integration.

en.name: Apache Flink
en.summary: Stream-first distributed processing engine. Iceberg integration via Flink connector.

en.name: Apache Paimon
en.summary: Streaming lakehouse format. Designed for low-latency stream-table convergence.

en.name: Iceberg paper
en.summary: The original Apache Iceberg design paper — argues for snapshot isolation as the foundation for a table format over object stores.

en.name: Iceberg 1.4 release notes
en.summary: Iceberg 1.4 release notes — introduces cross-engine sort orders so Spark / Flink / Trino agree on row layout.

en.name: RFC 9457
en.summary: Problem Details for HTTP APIs (IETF). Standard machine-readable error payload format used to wire structured errors into HTTP responses.
